newsitem.title: USA: Transamerican Waste to boost revs by $7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Transamerican Waste to boost revs by $7 mln.

text.p: TransAmerican Waste Industries Inc said Wednesday it has agreed to buy four businesses, a move that will boost its revenues by $7 million.
Total consideration for the acquistions are about $6.5 million, consisting of cash, stock and debt.
The deals are expected to close in August.
TransAmerica will have annualized revenue of more than $40 million when the deals are completed.
In Louisiana, the company agreed to acquire from Waste Management Inc and Omega One Co certain solid waste collection and transfer assets in Central Louisiana.
It also agreed to buy the stock of Boudin Waste and Recycling Inc, a solid waste collection company based in Mississippi.
In addition, the company completed the purchase of Target Waste Industries Inc, a commercial solid waste company in Alabama.
The company said it is making these acquistions to integrate its solid waste operations and bring additional waste streams into its landfills.
